mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where GDP y/y growth accelerates by > 2pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, signaled by a 3% m/m decline in the INDPRO index, indicates a supply shock that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of instances where INDPRO declines by > 3% m/m.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate, especially if it breaches 6%, signals a weakening labor market and slowing economy that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 45% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 6%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) are rising and consumer spending (RSAFS) is accelerating, it signals a strong consumer demand environment that will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS are both rising.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2% and falling, it signals an accommodative monetary policy that will support positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 35% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 2% and falling.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) is rising and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is falling, it signals a tightening labor market that will put upward pressure on wages and inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 45% of instances where PAYEMS is rising and UNRATE is falling.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 3% y/y signals rising inflationary pressures that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises > 3% y/y.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) is in a sustained decline and consumer spending (RSAFS) is falling, it signals a weakening demand environment that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances where GDPC1 and RSAFS are both declining.
